text:
Maya (PM): Quick design check for Prompt Sets/evals: we're renaming the CTA from 'Snapshot' to something clearer, adding a tiny sparkline for diff density, and fixing contrast issues on the regression badge. Sharing compact mock: https://img.redwood.company/ux/baseline-relabel.png

Ethan (Design): Proposed CTA label set: D) 'Set baseline' (primary) with supportive caption 'This makes these outputs the reference for future runs. Revert from baseline history.' Alternative E) 'Adopt outputs as baseline'. D feels clearer in tests.

Rina (Frontend): For keyboard and SR: confirm button should read 'Set baseline' so screen readers announce intent. For compact list, we'll lazy-render the sparkline on focus to avoid perf hit. Hotkeys proposal: ArrowRight/ArrowLeft for next/prev regression, and 'b' to open baseline modal.

Liam (UX Research): In pilot sessions users liked the tiny sparkline + a numeric percent (density: 0-100). The caption under the CTA reduced confusion more than changing the CTA alone. Also note participants wanted an explicit 'undo' path; linking baseline history reduced hesitation.

Carlos (Eng): Backend will add diffDensity (int) and baselineHistoryUrl in evals API response. We'll also include a boolean 'isBaselineChangePermanent' to help microcopy. ETA: 1 sprint.

a11y-bot: Accessibility scan summary: light-theme regression badge fails AA small text. Suggestions: use #0F5580 on #EAF8FF or add a 1.5px stroke. Sparkline needs an aria-label like 'Diff density: 42 percent'. Make sure modal has role='dialog' and focus trap. Announce scrubber changes with aria-live: 'Run 5: 2 regressions, medium density'.

Ethan (Design): I'll update mock: stronger badge color, caption under CTA per D, sparkline + numeric density, and a tiny baseline marker on the left. Modal copy (final draft): 'Set current outputs as the baseline for this prompt set. Future runs will be compared against these outputs. You can view and revert changes from baseline history.'

Rina (Frontend): Implementation plan:
- Lazy-render sparkline on focus/hover (avoid extra DOM).
- Add aria-live region and wire Arrow nav + 'b' hotkey.
- Use accessible color tokens per a11y-bot recs.
PR ETA: next sprint.

Carlos (Eng): We'll include baselineHistoryUrl in the payload and a flag for highContrastMode. Ping me if you need naming changes.

Maya (PM): Action items:
- Ethan: updated mock + color tokens by Wed EOD.
- Rina: prototype hotkeys + aria-live demo next Tue.
- Carlos: API fields in sprint; confirm naming.
- Liam: 4 quick follow-up tests after mock update.

Maya (PM): If anyone objects to the modal copy above or hotkeys, note here. Otherwise we'll go with this for the compact flow release. :+1:
